contract.name: BookDataSource
contract.description: Contract for providing logical Book data to SBBox-BookCatalog.

capability.name: BookDataSource
capability.responsibility: Provide a Book identified by a stable book identifier.

rules: The data source is identified by a stable book identifier.
The returned Book must conform to the logical Book model required by BookCatalog.
The data source does not control page navigation.
The data source does not control narration playback.
The data source does not render images.
The data source does not control reading sessions.
The data source may use any technology appropriate to its implementation.
Technology-specific details remain inside the adapter.
The adapter exposes WHAT Book data is available, not HOW the consuming Smart Box uses it.

errors.BOOK_NOT_FOUND: The requested book does not exist.
errors.BOOK_DATA_INVALID: The retrieved Book data is invalid.
